Community reports of small unsolicited transfers that appeared to come from HTX addresses that triggered AML-related account freezes on platforms like Coinbase

tweet.text:
关注到社区反馈的“部分地址收到来自 HTX 的小额转账”情况，我们第一时间进行了内部核查。

目前可以确认的是，HTX 官方未开展任何相关转账或测试行为。对于这些转账的具体来源及原因，我们正在进一步核实，不排除地址标记、链上转账来源识别等多种可能性，在事实确认前不做推测。

涉及用户账户及资产安全的问题，我们会认真对待，也会尽快查清楚。

有进一步确认的信息，我们会第一时间向社区同步，给大家一个明确的交代。

tweet.text:
stonkbrokers 'safelaunch' is kinda broken cuz it takes the 180eth (clockin example, was a rug token but is true for all tokens) in the curve at migration and splits it into two 90eth LPs

token/eth
token/stonkbrokers

but the 90eth swap into stonkbrokers to seed 2nd liquidity pool happens in a tiny v3 pool where it 10xed the price allowing a mev to extract 34eth from the mispricing

then the two token liquidity pools on migration are also significantly different prices
